title: Play the game of... Discovering Granada
text: Totally unexpected, this activity was worth while! By following each step on the map and the tasks assigned we discovered a large part of the Albaicin by ourselves and at our own rhythm! And we had so much fun with the riddles and games! What a great way to discover old Granada and its history!
author: Nadine_D

title: Granada walking tour
text: Fun way to become familiar with the city. Scavenger hunt made it more fun And good stretch of the legs!
author: Brenda_R

title: Granada is a vibrating...
text: Granada is a vibrating place and through the eyes of this tour I saw a different perspective that as showed us a new view of the city.
author: Patricia_F

title: Fun way to explore
text: We enjoyed the self-guided trail a lot. It is more interactive than a normal tour, but you still learn a lot of interesting facts and solve funny riddles.
author: Salome_K

title: I loved the trail!
text: I loved the trail! even though I’ve been to granada many times I’ve learned a lot of things in this trail and most importantly had a lot of fun! I will be sure to check more trails in other Spanish cities! Gracias 😊
author: Sydney_V

title: Nice way to discover Granada
text: I played the scavenger hunt with my boyfriend and we both loved it. We for sure do it again in a different city.
author: Madeleine_M

title: Fun
text: What a great way to discover a city!! Locking forward to the next one, highly recommended. We had a lot of fun
author: Caroline_A

title: So fun and exiting!
text: We have the best time while playing the Granada Trail! The clues are challenging and the group and photo tasks are so fun! We got to see a lot of the city and learn about its past. 10/10 experience
author: Beatriz_P

title: Different and entertaining
text: We would have liked more photographic challenges and that there would have been some degree of difficulty in being able to make the journey.
author: Patricia R

title: Good experience
text:
Very entertaining, and serves as a walk for an entire morning, or afternoon.
The only drawback is that in one of the places, the questions cannot be answered because the architecture and decoration of the place is completely changed. They should review that.
For the rest, it is very useful to learn at your own pace.
author: 953marciaa
